what: Uses a fixed 3-second delay for charge retry attempts instead of exponential backoff.
why: Stripe's batch endpoint throttles under sustained load and exponential backoff caused downstream timeouts.
revisit_condition: When Stripe's batch endpoint no longer throttles under load, allowing exponential backoff to be restored.
anchor_snippet:
wait = 3
logger.warning("rate limited on charge, waiting %ds (fixed)", wait)
